messages:
adele: Heads up — main flipped red right after merge (build 546789). Failing test: tests/transform/test_tokenize.py::test_batch_padding. Log shows IndexError in padding step. https://ci.internal/546789

sam: link? ping @priya since the change touch the tokenizer code in the PR.

devops-bot: Build 546789 failed on step 'unit-tests'. Exit code 1. Full log: https://ci.internal/546789/logs. Rerun available: https://ci.internal/546789/retry

priya: Thanks — I'm on PTO but can eyeball. Running quick local run now, can't repro locally yet. Can someone paste the failing stack from CI?

adele: paste from CI:
```
E   IndexError: list index out of range
venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/tokenize_utils.py:124 in pad_batch
    out[idx] = toks[idx + offset]
tests/transform/test_tokenize.py:42 in test_batch_padding
    assert padded.shape[1] == max_len
```

jordan: I can try a quick bisect if it keeps failing. Priya, what's the exact pytest command you run locally?

priya: pytest tests/transform/test_tokenize.py::test_batch_padding -q -k batch_padding -s --maxfail=1

sam: Can someone trigger the CI rerun first. If it passes we probably have a flaky; if it fails we kick off bisect. adele, can you retry?

adele: Triggered rerun (by adele): https://ci.internal/546789/retry (started)

devops-bot: Rerun 546789.1 started by adele.

(10m pass)
devops-bot: Rerun 546789.1 completed — status: PASSED.

sam: Passed. Looks flaky. I'll label the PR with flaky-test and file an infra ticket to increase test randomness coverage.

priya: Thanks. I'll open a follow-up PR to harden pad_batch and add a deterministic seed sweep for the test. Also adding a guard on index bounds so it fails with clearer message if it regresses.

jordan: If it reappears we can run bisect with `git bisect run ./scripts/run_flaky_check.sh` — I'll standby.

adele: Closing triage for now. Marking as flaky on the CI job, creating a short postmortem note in /docs/ci-flakes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
